candidates.text: Stochastic gradient descent optimizes objective functions by estimating gradients based on small random subsets of training data. Researchers must balance the computational efficiency of frequent against the variance of the gradient estimate to ensure the model converges to a generalizable solution rather than overfitting to specific samples.
